what: Every switch on the computer that suspends a safeguard of the starter (KALMIDO_APPROVAL_CHECK=0, KALMIDO_PERM_RELAY=0, KALMIDO_SESSION_RESUME=0, KALMIDO_DISPATCH further on than the setting in Kalmido, a removed dispatcher stop file) writes one line 'overridden: ...' into the runner's log when it starts and is counted in the dispatcher's day report (7 days); a new switch of that kind goes into agent_dispatch.OVERRIDE_SWITCHES, never without its log line
